s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic unilateral nasal obstruction with a polypoid mass
salient_findings: Large polypoid mass obstructing the left nasal cavity
Soft tissue polypoid density on computed tomographic imaging
CD138-positive and CD56-positive on pathological analysis
key_facts: 12-month history of left-sided nasal congestion and obstruction
Large polypoid mass obstructing the left nasal cavity on physical examination
Soft tissue polypoid density on computed tomographic imaging
Gains of fluorescence signal at multiple loci on fluorescence in situ hybridization
No local or distant metastatic disease on additional studies

raw.syndrome_frame: Chronic unilateral nasal obstruction with a polypoid mass
salient_findings: Large polypoid mass obstructing the left nasal cavity
Soft tissue polypoid density on computed tomographic imaging
CD138-positive and CD56-positive on pathological analysis
key_facts: 12-month history of left-sided nasal congestion and obstruction
Large polypoid mass obstructing the left nasal cavity on physical examination
Soft tissue polypoid density on computed tomographic imaging
Gains of fluorescence signal at multiple loci on fluorescence in situ hybridization
No local or distant metastatic disease on additional studies

raw.rationale: The presence of CD138 and CD56 positivity, along with EBV positivity and gains of fluorescence signal at multiple loci, suggests a lymphomatous process. The lack of CD20 and PAX5 expression, which are typical markers for B-cell lymphomas, may indicate a non-B-cell type of lymphoma, but the overall profile is more consistent with lymphoma than the other options.

rejected.label: diffuse large b cell lymphoma
rejected.why: CD20 and PAX5 negativity makes this less likely

rejected.label: lymphoepithelial carcinoma
rejected.why: The pathological analysis does not support carcinoma features

rejected.label: encapsulated sinonasal schwannoma
rejected.why: The presence of lymphoma markers and EBV positivity does not support a diagnosis of schwannoma

rejected.label: nasal septal schwannoma
rejected.why: The location and pathological findings do not support a diagnosis of schwannoma
